LanguageData.CC_Settings_Gods_Tip: The gods of this world, unseen. They act through the world's own events and moments, and the colonists talk of them: who they think was behind the storm, the old stories they grew up on, what visitors and neighbors tell. Nothing tells you what a god thinks. What the colony has seen, been told and believes is written in its own book of the gods, in the region window, and it may be wrong.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_Gods: Unseen gods, the colonists' talk of them, and the colony's own book of the gods.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_GodRealness_Tip: How plainly the gods act. Believed: nothing supernatural; the colonists see a god's hand in what happens anyway, and are sure of it. Felt (the default): the gods act, but never so plainly that nobody could doubt it, and someone always says it was only the weather. Walking: the gods show themselves openly, and nobody doubts it.
LanguageData.CC_GodRealness_Believed_Tip: Nothing supernatural: the gods are what the colony believes of them.
LanguageData.CC_GodRealness_Felt_Tip: The gods act, but never so plainly that nobody could doubt it.
LanguageData.CC_GodRealness_Walking_Tip: The gods show themselves openly, and nobody doubts it.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_GodRealness_Believed: The gods are believed in: nothing supernatural.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_GodRealness_Felt: The gods are felt, never so plainly that nobody could doubt it.
LanguageData.CC_God_Retired: The old ones' stories of the gods have changed, the way stories do. They tell them differently now, and nobody can quite remember how they went before.
LanguageData.CC_God_SpillAct_Against: galled by the honor done to {OTHER} ({TIE})
LanguageData.CC_God_SpillAct_With: glad of the honor done to {OTHER} ({TIE})
LanguageData.CC_God_Form_Spirit: a spirit, as tribes know the gods
LanguageData.CC_God_Form_Archotech: an archotech, one of the god-like minds
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Proud: Slow to be pleased and quick to take offense; neglect and scoffing gall it most, and it answers loudly.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Jealous: It wants to be the only one; honor done to its rivals galls it, and it forgets a kindness quickly and a slight slowly.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Generous: Easily pleased and slow to anger; what offends it is stinginess, the hungry and the stranger turned away.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Capricious: Its favor swings both ways, fast, and fades fast; it hates to be bored and to be forgotten.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Wrathful: Its anger is easily woken and long remembered; harm to its sacred things and scoffing offend it most.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Patient: Slow to warm and slow to cool, and it remembers both; only a broken word truly offends it.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Playful: Quick to be pleased and quick to forget; dullness bores it and a scoffer annoys it.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Cold: Exact and hard to move either way; a broken term is the only thing it takes badly, and it hardly ever answers aloud.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Grieving: It mourns something, and favor comes slowly to it; the dead left lying and its days let go hurt it most.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Ordinary: A god like most: it hears what is done in its domain, and answers by its nature.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Archotech: Cold and exact: it bargains in terms, keeps every term, and judges only deeds.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Hunger: The void: it answers anyone desperate enough, always pays what it promised, and always takes more.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Trickster: A trickster: it lies, and swaps a blessing for a curse and back again.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Dead: Silent: a few still keep it, but nobody living has heard it answer.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Newborn: Born of a colony's own faith, small and weak, growing with its devotion.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Fading: No worshippers left: it grows fainter every year.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Imprisoned: Held somewhere it cannot leave, and it wants out.
